listings.description: Spinnaker Solutions brings structure to complexity, clarifies priorities, and ensures communication drives action rather than confusion. Led by Kirk R. Benson, a retired Naval Officer, senior Navy Civilian, and former Commanding Officer, Spinnaker Solutions draws on decades of experience advising senior leaders, directing large portfolios, and helping organizations move from discussion to disciplined execution. Spinnaker Solutions also supports federal leadership development through an instructor partnership with Management Concepts, delivering professional development and leadership training to federal employees and military personnel nationwide.
